description: Reshape the selected output to 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 or 4:5. subject follows the subject; contain keeps the whole picture with bars; cover fills with optional x/y. add true creates another output and preserves this one. frame null restores the original shape. Crop only when requested. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

add.description: true: make this shape an extra output and keep this one.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

frame.description: The shape: ratio, fit (subject, cover or contain) and, with cover, the centre x/y from 0 to 1. null: the footage’s own shape.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

name: set_output_frame

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_output_frame result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change video shape
